description: Fork of exp104 with nap=10 only for out_proj (qk_joint and v_lut stay at nap=8). out_proj table_dim 256 -> 1024 (4x larger per-table). Per-layer LUT: qk/v 4.72M (unchanged), out_proj 16.78M (vs 4.19M, 4x). Total ~184M params. Tests whether out_proj benefits from extra capacity (its input H*d_v=384 is bigger than qk/v outputs 64, so out_proj is information bottleneck more than qk/v).
